children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Friday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.5% lower at C$1.3865 to the greenback, or 72.12 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3786 to 1.3871.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 2.2 basis points to 3.775%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.7862%.
futures fell $1.37 to $89.93 a barrel on Friday.
